# Addon compartment
## Integration
### Automatic registration
Addons can define the following metadata fields within their TOC file to control the automatic registration of their addon into the compartment. If the addon is load-on-demand, it will be loaded automatically if any of the functions specified in metadata fields need to be called.
| Field Name | Example Value | Description |
| AddonCompartmentFuncOnEnter | `MyAddOn_OnAddonCompartmentEnter` | The name of a global function to be executed when the compartment dropdown entry is highlighted. Optional. |
| AddonCompartmentFuncOnLeave | `MyAddOn_OnAddonCompartmentLeave` | The name of a global function to be executed when the compartment dropdown entry is no longer highlighted. Optional. |

...

The example below demonstrates the use of these TOC fields.
**MyAddOn.toc**
```
## Interface: 120007
## Title: My Addon
## Notes: Does something neat
## Author: Your Name
 ## AddonCompartmentFunc: MyAddOn_OnAddonCompartmentClick 
 ## AddonCompartmentFuncOnEnter: MyAddOn_OnAddonCompartmentEnter 
 ## AddonCompartmentFuncOnLeave: MyAddOn_OnAddonCompartmentLeave 
```

...

## Patch changes
* Dragonflight **Patch 10.1.0 (2023-05-02):** Addons can now register with the compartment through TOC metadata fields.
* Dragonflight **Patch 10.0.0 (2022-10-25):** Added.

# TOC format
## Interface version
### Determining the interface version
#### Warcraft Wiki
|Mists of Pandaria |Mists |`50504` |
|Cataclysm |Cata |`40402` |
|Wrath of the Lich King |Titan Reforged |`38001` |
|Wrath of the Lich King |Wrath |`30405` |
|Burning Crusade |TBC Test |`20505` |
|Burning Crusade |TBC |`20505` |
|World of Warcraft: Classic |Vanilla Test |`11508` |

...

## Per-line conditional directives
```
## Interface : 120007 
 ## Title : My Cool Addon 

 # This will only be loaded on Mainline. 
 MainlineOnly.lua [AllowLoadGameType mainline] 

 # This will only be loaded in Vanilla or TBC. 
 VanillaOrTBC.lua [AllowLoadGameType vanilla, tbc] 

```

...

## Per-file variables
| Variable | Description | Client version |
| [Game] | Expands out to either Standard , Vanilla , TBC , Wrath , Cata , Mists , WoWLabs , or WoWHack based upon the current active game type. | Added in 11.1.5 |
| [TextLocale] | Expands out to either enUS , deDE , frFR , etc. based upon the configured text locale of the game client. | Added in 11.2.0.61787 |
```
## Interface : 120007 
 ## Title : My Cool Addon 

 # This will load "Mainline\File.lua" or "Classic\File.lua" 
 # as appropriate for the current client. 
 [Family]\File.lua 

 # This will load "Standard\File.lua", "Mists\File.lua", "Cata\File.lua", ... 
 # as appropriate for the current client. 
```

...

## Client-specific TOC files
|Game Type |Expansion/Mode |Suffix |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
|`standard` |Midnight |Midnight excluding Plunderstorm |`AddonName _Standard .toc` |
|`mists` |Mists of Pandaria |Mists of Pandaria Classic |`AddonName _Mists .toc` |
|`cata` |Cataclysm |Cataclysm Classic |`AddonName _Cata .toc` |
|`wrath` |Wrath of the Lich King |Wrath of the Lich King Classic and Titan Reforged |`AddonName _Wrath .toc` |
|`tbc` |Burning Crusade |Burning Crusade Classic & Classic Anniversary Edition |`AddonName _TBC .toc` |
|`vanilla` |World of Warcraft: Classic |World of Warcraft Classic |`AddonName _Vanilla .toc` |

...

For example, having both a `_Cata.toc` and `_Classic.toc` file will result in the former being used on Cataclysm Classic clients, and the latter in all other Classic clients.

...

## Addon compartment integration
### AddonCompartmentFunc
Name of a global function to be executed when the dropdown list button for this addon has been clicked. This field is required to have the addon be shown in the Addon Compartment list.
```
## AddonCompartmentFunc : MyAddon_OnAddonCompartmentClick
```

...

## Loading conditions
### AllowLoadGameType
|Game Type |Expansion/Mode |
| --- | --- | --- |
|`standard` |Midnight |Midnight excluding Plunderstorm |
|`mists` |Mists of Pandaria |Mists of Pandaria Classic |
|`cata` |Cataclysm |Cataclysm Classic |
|`wrath` |Wrath of the Lich King |Wrath of the Lich King Classic and Titan Reforged |
|`tbc` |Burning Crusade |Burning Crusade Classic and Classic Anniversary Edition |
|`vanilla` |World of Warcraft: Classic |World of Warcraft Classic |
|`plunderstorm` |Midnight |Plunderstorm |
|`wowhack` |Midnight |Unknown |
|`mainline` |Midnight |Midnight including Plunderstorm and the unknown mode |
|`classic` | |All Classic expansions |

...

## Patch changes
### Modern
* Midnight **Patch 12.0.7 (2026-06-16):** Added support for per-metadata conditional directives.
* The War Within **Patch 11.2.0 (2025-08-05):** Added the inline `TextLocale` variable and `AllowLoadTextLocale` conditional directive.
* The War Within **Patch 11.1.7 (2025-06-17):** Added the `AllowAddOnTableAccess` field.
* The War Within **Patch 11.1.5 (2025-04-22):**
+ Added support for per-file conditional directives and variables.
+ Added the `LoadSavedVariablesFirst` field.
+ `AllowLoadGameType` is now usable by insecure addons.
* The War Within **Patch 11.1.0 (2025-02-25):** Added the `Category` and `Group` fields.
* The War Within **Patch 11.0.0 (2024-07-23):**
+ Added the restricted `UseSecureEnvironment` metadata field.
+ Removed the `SuppressLocalTableRef` metadata field.
* Dragonflight **Patch 10.2.7 (2024-05-07):**
+ Added support for comma-delimited `Interface` versions.
+ Added the restricted `SuppressLocalTableRef` metadata field.
+ Renamed `AllowLoadByGameMode` to `AllowLoadGameType` , and `GuardedAddOn` to `LoadFirst` .
* Dragonflight **Patch 10.2.6 (2024-03-19):** Added the restricted `AllowLoadByGameMode` metadata field.
* Dragonflight **Patch 10.1.0 (2023-05-02):**
+ Added `IconAtlas` , `IconTexture` , and Addon compartment related metadata fields.
+ Added the restricted `GuardedAddOn` metadata field.
* Shadowlands **Patch 9.1.0 (2021-06-29):** Multiple TOC files are now supported using a suffix to disambiguate Classic, BCC and Retail. [[ 1 ]]()
* Shadowlands **Patch 9.0.1 (2020-10-13):** `/reload` recognizes changes to TOC metadata and entirely new files in the `Interface/AddOns/` directory tree.
* Cataclysm **Patch 4.0.1 (2010-10-12):** `/reload` recognizes changes to the file order.
* Burning Crusade **Patch 2.1.0 (2007-05-22):** Added the `LoadManagers` metadata field.
* World of Warcraft **Patch 1.11.0 (2006-06-19):** Added the `Secure` metadata field.
* World of Warcraft **Patch 1.9.0 (2006-01-03):** Added the `LoadWith` metadata field.

...

### Classic Progression
* Cataclysm **Patch 4.4.1 (2024-10-29):** Includes all Modern changes up to 11.0.0.
* Cataclysm **Patch 4.4.0 (2024-04-30):**
+ Includes all Modern changes up to 10.2.7.
+ The behavior of the `_Classic` TOC suffix has changed such that it now loads on all Classic clients, and not just Classic Era.
* Burning Crusade **Patch 2.5.3 (2022-01-18):** `/reload` recognizes changes to TOC metadata and entirely new files in the `Interface/AddOns/` directory tree.
* Burning Crusade **Patch 2.5.1 (2021-05-18):** Multiple TOC files are now supported using a suffix to disambiguate Classic, BCC and Retail. [[ 1 ]]()
* World of Warcraft: Classic **Patch 1.13.2 (2019-08-26):** Includes all Modern changes up to 8.1.0.

### Classic Era
* World of Warcraft: Classic **[Patch 1.15.8](https://warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/Patch_1.15.8/API_changes?action=edit&redlink=1 "Patch 1.15.8/API changes (page does not exist)") (2025-10-21):** Includes all Modern changes up to 11.2.0.
* World of Warcraft: Classic **Patch 1.15.4 (2024-09-24):** Includes all Modern changes up to 11.0.0.
* World of Warcraft: Classic **Patch 1.14.0 (2021-09-28):**
+ Includes all Classic Progression changes up to 2.5.2.
+ `/reload` recognizes changes to TOC metadata and entirely new files in the `Interface/AddOns/` directory tree.
* World of Warcraft: Classic **Patch 1.13.7 (2021-04-20):** Multiple TOC files are now supported using a suffix to disambiguate Classic, BCC and Retail. [[ 1 ]]()

### Classic Titan Reforged
* Wrath of the Lich King **[Patch 3.80.0](https://warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/Patch_3.80.0/API_changes?action=edit&redlink=1 "Patch 3.80.0/API changes (page does not exist)") (2025-11-18):**
+ Includes all Classic Era changes up to 1.15.8.
+ The behavior of the `_Classic` TOC suffix has changed such that it now loads on all Classic clients, and not just Classic Era.

### Classic Anniversary
* Burning Crusade **[Patch 2.5.5](https://warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/Patch_2.5.5/API_changes?action=edit&redlink=1 "Patch 2.5.5/API changes (page does not exist)") (2026-01-13):**
+ Includes all all Classic Era changes up to 1.15.8.
+ The behavior of the `_Classic` TOC suffix has changed such that it now loads on all Classic clients, and not just Classic Era.
+ The legacy TOC suffix `-BCC` is no longer supported.
